claude_proposed_widenings.name: negate_incoming_critical_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has outgoing crit-range modification for the wearer/attacker, but no honest way to express a passive defensive rule that converts critical hits against the wearer into normal hits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.
